_comment: Claude Desktop MCP server configuration for @atlasent/mcp-server.

atlasent-stdio._comment: Recommended: stdio transport (no network exposure, works out of the box).

env._base_url_note: Use your runtime base ending in /functions/v1, e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1. The api.atlasent.io apex 404s unless a custom domain is verified for your tenant.

atlasent-stdio-local._comment: Local mode — no API key required. Uses built-in rules engine for development.

atlasent-http._comment: HTTP transport — start the server first: ATLASENT_MCP_TRANSPORT=streamable-http npx @atlasent/mcp-server
atlasent-http._note: Claude Desktop does not yet natively proxy HTTP MCP servers; use a local proxy or the stdio transport above.

env._base_url_note: Use your runtime base ending in /functions/v1, e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/functions/v1. The api.atlasent.io apex 404s unless a custom domain is verified for your tenant.
